definitions.explanation: used to ask about the number of times something has occurred or will occur

examples.japanese: {何回|なんかい}⟦{言|い}ったら→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: How many times do I have to tell you before you understand?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何回|なんかい}⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many times have you been to Japan?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何回|なんかい}⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I watch this movie, I never get tired of it.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what, how many) + ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (times, counter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何回|なんかい} ≈ ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧ (how many times)
- {何回|なんかい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ - many times
- {何回|なんかい}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ - several times

COUNTER QUESTIONS PATTERN:
- ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧ - how many people
- ⟦{何歳|なんさい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧ - how old
- ⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧ - how many (flat objects)
- ⟦{何冊|なんさつ}→何冊：08778_nansatsu⟧ - how many books
- ⟦{何杯|なんばい}→何杯：08779_nanbai⟧ - how many cups

USAGE:
- {何回|なんかい} tends to be used for concrete, countable repetitions
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧ can be more abstract or emotional
